architecturalApproach: Redesigned heading recognition around compositional, non-lexical evidence rather than patching the 4 isolated cases Part B's recertification found as special cases, per this phase's own explicit anti-special-casing charter.

threeGeneralFixesApplied.defect: Lowercase 'section'/'article' keyword mid-sentence (not at a line start) invisible
threeGeneralFixesApplied.mechanism: ciKeyword() - makes ONLY the fixed keyword spelling case-insensitive via a per-letter [Xx] alternation, applied to ARTICLE_PATTERNS[0]/SECTION_PATTERNS[0]/INTEGER_SECTION_PATTERNS[0]. Deliberately does NOT use the whole-regex `i` flag, which would also relax the title-shape character classes ([A-Z]... for a heading's own title span) - the real distinguishing evidence between a heading-shaped title and an ordinary lowercase sentence continuation. Keyword spelling case carries no evidentiary weight (typographic noise); a title's own capitalization remains genuine positive evidence and is left fully intact.
threeGeneralFixesApplied.generalizesBeyond: This is a root-cause fix applied uniformly at every keyword-anchored shape-based pattern in the file, not a single case-insensitive flag bolted onto one regex.

threeGeneralFixesApplied.defect: Footnote-marker digit glued to terminal punctuation with only one newline before the next heading drops the heading, corrupting the rank stack
threeGeneralFixesApplied.mechanism: stripTrailingPageNumberArtifact/stripTrailingFootnoteMarker generalized into discounting a real typographic-noise CLASS (page/running-footer labels in any case via a proper `i` flag; a footnote/endnote reference marker glued to real terminal punctuation with no intervening whitespace) applied uniformly to both positional signals and both ARTICLE and SECTION candidates, BEFORE either signal is evaluated. Root-cause, not a rank-stack patch: an ARTICLE that would have been dropped (re-parenting its real child SECTION to parentSectionRef=null) is instead never dropped, because the noise hiding its real positional evidence is discounted first.
threeGeneralFixesApplied.alsoFixes: The ALL-CAPS 'PAGE' running-footer artifact gap (originally reported separately as the 4th Part B finding), via the same `i` flag fix.

threeGeneralFixesApplied.defect: BOUNDED_GAP - a related, pre-existing latent defect surfaced (not introduced) while implementing fix #1
threeGeneralFixesApplied.mechanism: ARTICLE_PATTERNS[0]'s unbounded number-to-title whitespace could span an entire paragraph break, so a bare citation with no title of its own could balloon-match across a blank line and swallow a distinct, later, real ARTICLE heading as its own title - silently deleting it. Confirmed via direct regex probing that this reproduces against the ORIGINAL, unmodified pattern too (orthogonal to case; merely never previously exercised by any committed test). Fixed by bounding the number-to-title gap to at most one newline everywhere it occurs, matching how every real heading's own number and title actually sit relative to each other. Applied uniformly across all three affected patterns.

deliberatelyNotFixed.defect: Multi-column-layout collapse (the 3rd of Part B's 4 findings, a single-newline heading with no terminal punctuation dropped/merged after a table/list/signature block)
deliberatelyNotFixed.reasoning: Constructed and ran a concrete counter-test proving that any general 'single newline + no terminal punctuation' acceptance path (e.g. sequential section-numbering continuity) necessarily reopens the existing, already zero-recertified Category 6 precision boundary in structural-heading-rx-adversarial-expansion.test.ts (a numeric table row immediately followed by the next section number, separated by exactly this shape, must NOT become a heading). This residual is the same examined boundary Workstream A's own prior RX pass already accepted, now hit via a differently-named mechanism - not a new, independently fixable defect. Recording this honestly rather than claiming false generality.
deliberatelyNotFixed.testUpdate: tests/certification/part-b-recert-blocker1-independent-adversarial.test.ts's Section 3 assertions are UNCHANGED (still documents the heading as correctly, currently dropped), with the counter-test proof of why fixing it generally would reopen Category 6 added to the file's own header comment.
